formula: score = w_rel·REL + w_nov·NOV + w_fresh·FRESH + w_div·DIV + w_cult·CULT + w_ctx·CTX

signals.CTX: session fit: sampler-derived time-of-day patterns matched against album energy/duration profiles
signals.CULT: cultural-discourse score: canon membership, year-end-list appearances, review volume, RYM rating counts
signals.DIV: marginal contribution to the week's diversity (quality-diversity trade-off)
signals.FRESH: release recency, budgeted separately from NOV per YouTube 2607.23749
signals.NOV: inverse familiarity: unplayed, low co-occurrence with his library
signals.REL: dot product of taste vector with album embedding (collaborative core)

wild_card.REL_floor: hard floor — never below 0.25 regardless of tuning
